about: Ledger ratchet: per-file counts that may only go down (scripts/check-ledger.mjs). The 6.0 cut needs every count at zero.

categories.outline: outlines other than a focus ring (outside :focus and :focus-visible rules)
categories.shadow: shadows other than a marked token's 2px same-colour spread (the tip's --float is Ledger's own)
categories.easing: easing other than Ledger's one curve
categories.mix: colour mixes outside oklch and oklab (the accent mixes in oklch; a grey mixes in oklab, since Chrome gives a near-grey's powerless oklch hue a red cast)
categories.tintText: text coloured by the depth accent (--tint, --deep or --late)
